title: Employee Equipment Approval Form
use_case: Use the approval form during employee equipment request, custody, and return when the employee equipment record must identify employee, manager, role, location, device or asset, accessories, software, cost center, and employment event. Complete the applicable handoff for custody acknowledgment, inventory update, support handoff, return due date, recovered condition, and access deprovisioning.
